params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch strictly focuses on renaming fields and method parameters to comply with the naming convention `^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$`. All changes are consistent with this goal, converting snake_case or uppercase field names to camelCase without altering logic or adding/removing unrelated code. Minor formatting and comment adjustments are acceptable and do not affect functionality. There are no unrelated or unnecessary modifications.

Score: 3
